name: Res Arcana
summary: Alchemical mages collect essences to build artifacts, tame dragons and claim monuments to reach 10 victory points.
rules_text: Each player gets 1 of each essence, 2 random mages and 8 random artifacts. Choose 1 mage and draw 3 artifacts as hand; the rest is your deck. 2 monuments face-up plus deck and 5 Places of Power are in center. 8 magic items in supply. Each round: first Collect phase - trigger all your Collect abilities to gain essences and optionally take any essences sitting on your components. Then action phase clockwise from first player: on your turn you must either place an artifact from hand paying its essence cost, claim a face-up or top-deck monument for 4 Gold or a Place of Power paying its cost, discard an artifact for 1 Gold or any 2 other essences, use a power on a straightened component paying its cost and turning it if required, or pass. Passing gives you first-player token if first to pass, you must swap your magic item, and you draw 1 artifact. Once all passed, check if any player has 10+ points from artifacts, monuments and places. If so, most points wins; tie-break unused essences. Otherwise straighten all components and start new round.
rating_reason: Drafting engine builder, hidden hands, artifact building fits engine
